title: North Korea Fires Multiple Ballistic Missiles into Sea of Japan
detail: North Korea launched multiple ballistic missiles toward the Sea of Japan (East Sea), with South Korea's military confirming multiple launches. Seoul urged Pyongyang to stop UN violations as the projectiles were tracked off North Korea's east coast. Japan and South Korea issued alerts and condemned the launches as violations of UN Security Council resolutions.

media.caption: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles into Sea of Japan

title: South Korea and Ukraine in Diplomatic Dispute Over North Korean POWs
detail: South Korea and Ukraine face an unresolved diplomatic dispute over North Korean prisoners of war captured during the Ukraine conflict. Questions remain about whether the POWs should be repatriated to North Korea, handed to South Korea, or detained under a third arrangement, straining bilateral relations between Seoul and Kyiv.

media.caption: North Korean POWs captured in Ukraine at center of Seoul-Kyiv diplomatic dispute
